criteria: OAUTH-01 Explicit canonical APP_ORIGIN determines issuer/resource; only an explicit NODE_ENV=test loopback override allows HTTP/ports.
OAUTH-02 Bounded CIMD fetch only from strict HTTPS claude.ai non-root URLs; no credentials/query/fragment/port/redirect; exact document identity and exact hosted callback.
OAUTH-03 DCR admits only the exact hosted callback and public none authentication, with shared fail-closed 5/minute and 20/hour limits, global 1000 cap and active-grant retention.
OAUTH-04 Code/S256/client/redirect/resource binding is exact; requests expire in ten minutes, codes in five, access in at most fifteen, family in thirty absolute days.
OAUTH-05 Consent requires live cookie session, exact Origin, browser/request/actor/session binding and single-use CSRF/decision; project selection is explicit, paginated and live-authorized.
OAUTH-06 No membership or board grant is created; current Owner inheritance and active non-Owner membership are preserved; ordinary tool authorization remains the parent-owned board boundary.

OAUTH-07 Code redemption and refresh issuance are atomic; separate-connection races cannot fork tokens; correctly bound reuse commits family revocation; wrong-client attempts cannot revoke victim grants.
OAUTH-08 Connection/access row locks precede existing project/board locks, conflict with revocation and deny subsequent operation/replay; stable connection ID survives refresh.
OAUTH-09 Raw codes/access/refresh/browser/CSRF credentials are never persisted in tables/logs/receipts/activity; strict response schemas prevent credential/internal-field leakage.
OAUTH-10 Own connection settings remain actor-owned and conceal new project metadata after membership loss; disconnect and OAuth revocation invalidate the family.
OAUTH-11 Bounded bodies, declared-Origin checks, standard OAuth errors, no-store responses, database-time expiry and failure rollback hold under the real mounted route module.

OAUTH-12 Additive PostgreSQL migration replays safely and matches embedded SQL; existing public PAT/session behavior is unchanged by this component. Integrated API/Worker/PAT regression remains mandatory before complete connector acceptance.

OAUTH-13 Consent and own connection summaries explicitly disclose offline persistence. Consent reports accessTokenLifetimeSeconds900, connectionLifetimeDays30 and refreshTokenIdleDays7 only when offlineAccess is true, otherwise null. Refresh issuance remains conditional on the approved offline_access scope.

OAUTH-14 Bounded scheduled retention preserves every code/refresh hash of retained families, keeps terminal connection identity for at least seven days after the conservative terminal/last-use anchor, deletes only orphan expired requests and protects live clients/pending authorization. SKIP LOCKED, hard100cap, real self-FK cascade, idempotence, scheduler rollback/continuation and immediate post-decision redaction pass isolated PostgreSQL tests.

OAUTH-15 Worker request pools remain alive until all reported image/MCP work truly settles, including rejected work. waitUntil retains asynchronous closure; without execution context closure is awaited. Mounted transport supplies the callback and its full integration remains part of final feature acceptance.

OAUTH-16 Exact OAuth/consent write paths enforce cancellable16KiB raw-byte reads and deadlines before generic buffering, including unfinished oversized/slow/already-aborted input. Cached JSON/form parsing preserves authority gates; actual downstream DB work is retained after HTTP timeout. Actual mounted regression evidence is mandatory.

TRANSPORT-01 Exact canonical OAuth-only MCP entry authenticates before SDK; cookies/PAT/query credentials and forged request identity cannot substitute; external OAuth remains invalid on REST/session/admin routes.

TRANSPORT-02 Exact discovery metadata, stateless JSON Streamable HTTP and five existing tools work; initialize, notification, list, call, errors, Accept/content-type/method/Origin/CORS and protocol bounds execute under Node and actual workerd.
TRANSPORT-03 Module-private Request identity retains principal and the same request pool; clones/headers cannot mint authority; no OAuth-to-PAT conversion or external arbitrary REST proxy exists.

TRANSPORT-04 Selected project and current Owner/Manager/Member/Viewer, membership and board grants remain authoritative for every operation and receipt retry; sibling/hidden board data is not exposed.

TRANSPORT-05 Create holds credential and live project/board/assignee authority through receipt/card/activity commit; stable connection ID binds semantic retries across refresh; changed input conflicts; concurrent revoke/create and grant removal cannot authorize later writes.

TRANSPORT-06 Protocol128KiB and JSON depth32 limits, no batches, connection120/minute/create30/minute fail-closed counters, deadlines and real-work cleanup are bounded. Declared/streamed oversize cancellation never blocks on uncooperative source cleanup; already-aborted and queued verification settle without later dispatch.
TRANSPORT-07 Unexpected errors and response projections never disclose raw credentials or SQL/provider diagnostics; receipts and safe mcp_oauth activity preserve privacy and one logical effect.

TRANSPORT-08 Existing full API/contracts/MCP/packed executable, typecheck/build, OpenAPI and embedded migration checks pass on the held target; no SQLite/mocked/native-helper claim substitutes for real PostgreSQL/Worker evidence.

HUI-01: Signed-out direct load to a real pending request. Continue with Google retains exact handle, synthetic provider roundtrip returns to that consent, name step if required retains URL; no landing-page detour or project disclosure while signed out. Bad/duplicate request input cannot enter a redirect.

HUI-02: Owner sees canonical name/origins, visible unverified warning, exact four permission labels, one explicit blank project choice and both decisions. Hidden sibling project/board names remain absent. Allow is disabled until choice; no All projects option.

HUI-03: Approve exactly one project. Capture only safe POST structural facts, one outcome and a callback matching exact scheme/host/path. No submitted redirect URI/scopes/client ID fields. Double click does not create two grants/codes. Callback is intercepted locally.
HUI-04: Deny with no project selection. POST omits projectId; callback error is access_denied, no code, and SQL count for own grants is unchanged. Reload/repeat cannot approve the consumed request.

HUI-05: Unknown, malformed, expired, missing browser binding and consumed requests show the generic unavailable state, no project/client leak, and disabled/absent allow. Expire synthetic row directly; do not wait10minutes.

HUI-06: Complete consent as Owner, Manager, Member and Viewer. The grant selects one existing project without inventing board authority. Viewer copy says actions remain limited by role; a grant cannot make a Viewer create cards. Personal Connections works for all four roles and an account with no projects.

HUI-07: Continuing-access and access-token-only requests show distinct truthful duration text on consent and Connections. For false, no7day/30day continuing-access claim; for true, all15minute/7day/30day policies appear.

HUI-08: More than100 currently accessible projects: Load more preserves current explicit selection, appends distinct choices, honors nextCursor and submits newest CSRF. Loading next page does not automatically choose another project or reset permissions.

HUI-09: Switch actor/session after consent GET. Old project/client details are removed and the decision fails closed; membership removal between view and allow fails. Reload obtains canonical state rather than retrying the old CSRF or replacing project choice silently.

HUI-10: Connections shows safe app/project/scopes/date/expiry and “Not recorded” for null last use; no success/last-use claim inferred from approval. Disconnect confirmation names the app/project; Escape preserves grant and returns focus, confirm sends one DELETE204 and removes row. Direct same-user repeated DELETE stays204; outsider ID remains non-disclosing.

HUI-11: Lost decision response, OAuth400/401/403/404/409/429/503 and non-JSON faults show local copy and safe recovery. No raw SQL/stack/provider message, URL/code/secret or exception text. Honor Retry-After; no auto-post on GET/reload. Failed POST state is unknown, not falsely approved/denied.

HUI-12: Malicious client name is inert text, no remote logo/script fetch. Record console warnings/errors, page errors, unexpected API failures, external origins and DOM diagnostic/credential-pattern scan; successful cases require zero unexpected events. Expected security refusals are recorded by status/path only.

HUI-13: Keyboard-only choice/allow/deny/navigation/disconnect, visible focus and alert/status names; dialog Escape/focus restore;320px/200% zoom and long names fit without clipped action controls. Capture consent and Connections screenshots only before callback URLs contain codes.

HUI-14: Built static export through actual Pages Functions: direct `/connect` load/refresh works; all exact well-known metadata aliases proxy with protocol JSON and no sign-in redirect; existing `/api/*` no-store/cookies survive. Next dev evidence does not close this case.

HUI-15: Current unchanged stdio/PAT/browser flows, actual mounted OAuth→MCP tool calls and post-disconnect rejection pass final integration suites. The draft UI composition is not proof of private dispatcher or Worker behavior.
